items.title: Server may trust a user identifier sent by the settings form
30-day cookie keeps old sessions alive after the account details change
Cross-site request forgery can change a victim's email and address
Hijacked session becomes full account takeover because email change needs no password
Personal data exposed to unauthorised users
New email address is accepted without proving the user owns it
Shipping address can be rewritten to divert goods
Email change is silent, so a hijack goes unnoticed and undisputed
